svg.text: CAREFLOW OPD — OVERALL SYSTEM SEQUENCE
Standalone prototype flow · Patient + Admin · Browser-local demo storage
Patient
Admin
CareFlow UI
Application Logic
Browser Local Storage
Notification UI
1. Authentication and role routing
Open CareFlow OPD and choose Sign in
Submit email and password
Read saved demo user records
Return matching user, role and account status
Save current user session
Return authenticated role and account state
Display Patient or Admin dashboard
2. Patient searches and books
Open Find a Doctor and select a doctor
Request active doctor profile and schedule
Read doctor records and existing appointments
Return doctor details and available slots
Display doctor details, dates and available times
Choose date/time and enter optional visit reason
Submit booking request
Check account, doctor schedule, duplicate and slot availability
Return validation result
If duplicate: return booking error; otherwise continue
Generate next token for doctor and date
Save appointment, visit reason and token
Confirm appointment record saved
Save booking notifications for patient and admin
Refresh unread notification records
Update notification bell and unread count
Return booking confirmation and token number
Display confirmation and personal token
3. Patient manages appointments
Open My Appointments / Token Queue
Request patient-owned appointments and tokens
Read appointments belonging to current patient
Return personal bookings and stored statuses
Display appointment details and personal status
Choose Cancel or Reschedule for an eligible Waiting booking
Validate ownership, status and selected replacement slot
Update existing appointment for reschedule, or mark Cancelled
Confirm appointment change
Save patient and admin change notifications
Return updated booking information
Display cancellation/reschedule result
For a Completed visit, choose Book follow-up
Validate completed source visit and selected slot
Create a separate follow-up appointment linked to original visit
Return new follow-up token; retain original Completed record
Save follow-up notifications
Return follow-up confirmation
Display new follow-up appointment and token
4. Admin monitors and manages operations
Sign in and open Admin Dashboard
Authenticate Admin role
Read admin account and session data
Return Admin account record
Display Admin workspace
Open Dashboard / Appointments
Request appointment, token, doctor and patient summaries
Read stored appointment, doctor and patient records
Return records and status values
Render dashboard statistics and read-only appointment rows
Display monitoring data; no status-edit controls
Open Doctors & Schedules and save doctor changes
Validate doctor profile and schedule input
Save doctor profile and schedule changes
Confirm doctor data saved
Refresh doctor management view
Open Patient Accounts; choose Ban or Restore
Validate target patient account and admin permission
Update patient account access status
Confirm Active/Banned status saved
Save account notifications for patient and admin
Refresh account notification records
Update notification badge and list
Return account status and confirmation
Display updated patient account status
Edit Admin profile and save details
Validate name, email and contact number
Save Admin profile fields
Confirm profile update
Return updated profile
Display saved Admin profile
5. Notification viewing
Click notification bell / select notification
(Admin can perform the same notification actions)
Load notifications for signed-in user
Read user notifications and read/unread state
Return notification records
Render notification panel and unread count
Display notifications; mark one/all as read
Save read timestamp for selected notification(s)
Persist notification read state
Confirm notification state saved
Implementation boundary
Current standalone HTML prototype uses browser localStorage for demo users, doctors, appointments,
account status and notifications. It has no connected backend or shared database.
Production integration required
Validated queue/clinical events must update appointment statuses and trigger status-change
notifications. Admin remains read-only for appointment status.
Legend: Solid arrow = request/action · Dashed arrow = response · Yellow bar = activation · Duplicate booking returns an error; available slot continues to token generation.
